meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会接入你的某个 Linear 团队频道,参与 issue 的评论线程。每条评论都会触发它,不需要 @ 提及;每个 issue 的评论线程各自成为一个独立会话。
howto.when: 当你在已接入团队的 Linear issue 下发表评论时,它就接管。不需要 @ 提及——Linear 的 webhook 会把评论事件直接发给它。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接进 NanoClaw
say.note: 按步骤复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 我想用 Personal API Key 的方式接 Linear
say.note: 它以你的身份发评论,你自己的评论会被过滤掉

say.text: Linear 评论一直收不到,帮我排查
say.note: 检查 webhook URL、团队选择和签名密钥

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins a Linear team channel and takes part in issue comment threads. Every comment triggers it, with no @-mention needed, and each issue thread becomes its own separate conversation.
howto.when_en: It takes over when a comment is posted on an issue in the wired Linear team. No @-mention is needed — the Linear webhook sends comment events straight to it.

say_en.text: Wire the Linear channel into NanoClaw for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep and runs the test

say_en.text: I want to connect Linear with a Personal API Key
say_en.note: It posts as you; your own comments get filtered

say_en.text: Linear comments never arrive, help me debug
say_en.note: Checks webhook URL, team and signing secret
